summary: Iteration 35: PDF Reports Feature - All tests passed (24/24 backend, all frontend UI verified). New endpoints: GET /api/reports/filtered-feed (export filtered intelligence as PDF), GET /api/reports/regional-threat (regional threat summary PDF), GET /api/reports/cross-border-sitrep (cross-border SITREP PDF for Bangladesh/Myanmar), GET /api/reports/custom (custom filtered report PDF). All endpoints require authentication (401 without token), return application/pdf content type. Reports page accessible from sidebar with 3 collapsible report cards. Intelligence Feed page has new Export PDF button.
